description: Researches a prospect and their company, then writes personalized outreach: a first email or LinkedIn message, three subject-line variants, a connection request, and a multi-touch follow-up sequence with a fresh angle on every touch. Checks CRM history and opt-out status first. Use when a rep asks to write a cold or re-engagement email, prospect a named contact, draft a LinkedIn note or InMail, build a follow-up cadence, or find personalization hooks for someone they want to reach.
